BAD_REQUEST: We couldn't process that request. Check the details and try again.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this. Contact your administrator if you think this is a mistake.
NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
CONFLICT: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: This is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Contact your Loons account manager.
EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
STAFF_MUST_USE_SSO: Loons staff sign in with Microsoft from the Support login page.
STAFF_DOMAIN_REQUIRED: Support login requires a @loonsgroup.com staff email.
CLIENT_PORTAL_ONLY: Client accounts sign in from the client portal.
EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your Google email address, then try again.
RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
SIGNIN_FAILED: We couldn't sign you in. Try again.
CONFIGURATION: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
